text.p: Matches scheduled in the French first division this week (standings in parentheses, all kickoff times GMT):

Battle for France's second place in European Champions' League. Bastia are unbeaten at home this year while PSG, despite superb Cup Winners' Cup form, have lost last two away games and will be without suspended captain Rai and midfielder Benoit Cauet.
Lyon are in form with three wins in a row, the last against champions Auxerre. Rennes have not won in nine games this year.

Bottom club Nice, doomed to relegation, treat league games as preparation for the French Cup where they meet second division Laval in semifinals at weekend. Lens, unbeaten in three games, need victory in fight to avoid going down with Nice.
Defending champions risk missing out on Europe next season if they drop many more points but should manage to bounce back from 1-0 loss at Lyon 10 days ago.
Mid-table clash of two teams who both started the season in Europe but look unlikely to qualify next year.
Monaco will virtually seal sixth championship if they win on tough trip to Bordeaux and PSG lose to Bastia in Corsica.
French Cup semifinalists Montpellier aim to stretch unbeaten run in league to 12 games, while Marseille, looking to make up for disappointing season, go for second home win in row.
Nantes can take their remarkable unbeaten run to 26 games against Strasbourg, who could be forgiven for relaxing after securing European berth with League Cup victory on Saturday.
Relegation clash in which a draw would probably condemn both teams to second division.

Lille, who have not scored in last three games which were all defeats, occupy the fourth relegation spot and can only hope Cannes, with only four goals in nine league games this year, confirm their record of having the worst attack in top flight.
